tasks.title: Desktop Coder start fails: "the granted source snapshot is unavailable or changed"
tasks.prompt: A desktop Coder start can fail with “the granted source snapshot is unavailable or changed” even when its source is readable and within the admitted entry and byte limits. A source tree with many sibling directories reproduces an incomplete observation caused by exhausting the process's open-file limit. Fix source observation so a wide tree can be completely observed within its resource budget. Preserve the existing no-follow boundary for links, completeness reporting, entry and byte limits, and change detection. Add a focused regression test. Work within the source-observation and admission code needed for this behavior; do not weaken admission to accept an incomplete snapshot.

public_requirement_provenance.scope: Normalized bounded behavior slice of the historical issue. It does not assert full issue closure or replay deployment/owner-machine instructions. Original public issue plus independent safety controls, finalized before candidate model trials.

tasks.title: Engine lookup falls back to an old ~/.openagents/bin/microcoder when the running binary was rebuilt (Linux "(deleted)" path)
tasks.prompt: On Linux, a running OpenAgents program can be replaced by a rebuild while it continues running. Engine discovery then falls back to an older `~/.openagents/bin/microcoder` even though a fresh `microcoder` is beside the program. Linux can report the running executable with a trailing ` (deleted)` marker. Fix `default_controller` in `crates/coder/src/task/autostart.rs` so the sibling engine remains preferred after replacement, while preserving ordinary sibling selection and installed-engine fallback when no sibling exists. Report a missing engine when neither location is available. Add a regression test without touching installed programs.

tasks.title: Task store v2 still refuses with "another process holds the task store lock"
tasks.prompt: Parallel chat work can still fail with “another process holds the task store lock” after the move to one file per task. Inspect task admission and owner/store locking in `crates/coder/src/task/`, including `Store::open_for_owner`. Make short-lived contention wait briefly instead of refusing an otherwise valid start, and keep unrelated tasks independent. Preserve exclusive execution for one task: a command must not run while another owner holds that task's lock. Add regression coverage for contention and independent starts. Keep changes within the locking/admission behavior; do not change record formats, task cleanup, or engine execution policy.

tasks.title: Fetch the one tracked branch before creating a chat-run worktree (no refspec changes)
tasks.prompt: Before creating a chat-run worktree from a branch that tracks a remote branch, refresh that tracked branch with a bounded fetch. Start from the newer remote commit when the local branch is simply behind; preserve the user's local work when it is ahead or diverged. On an unavailable remote, continue from the cached/local state. Fetch only the branch needed, do not add or rewrite refspecs, and leave the user's checkout unchanged. Cover a local bare origin and offline fallback. Find the chat-run worktree creation in `crates/coder/src/task/`; preserve existing parallel-fetch locking and spare-worktree safety.
